os-3-3.alt: Two sheets of phospholipids lined up tail to tail. The water-loving heads of the outer sheet face the fluid outside the cell, the heads of the inner sheet face the cytoplasm, and the water-avoiding tails meet in the middle of the membrane.

os-3-4.alt: A section of plasma membrane: a phospholipid bilayer with proteins spanning it or sitting on its surfaces, cholesterol tucked between the phospholipids, and sugar chains attached to some proteins and lipids on the outer face.
